$comment: Machine-readable mirror of docs/dev/FEATURE_MATRIX.md — the 'second brain'. Tool <-> code <-> status <-> TestFlight acceptance. Regenerate/update whenever FEATURE_MATRIX.md changes. Truth-source: this file + the code; docs/architecture.html is the human mirror.

tools.name: EchoelSynth
tools.live: DDSP/modal/cellular synthesis, one-shot sampler, bio-reactive audible voice
tools.acceptance: Play toggle opens envelope and produces sound; bio frames modulate timbre

tools.name: EchoelFX
tools.live: Convolution reverb (HRV-reactive), 4-band EQ + LUFS auto-gain (-14 LUFS), LFO-swept SVF, tanh saturation
tools.acceptance: Export applies AutoMix to -14 LUFS without clipping

tools.name: EchoelMix
tools.live: master bus, mic 1024-pt FFT, 30s CAF pre-roll, LUFS WAV/AAC export
tools.roadmap: MultiTrackRecorder (skeleton), console UI, FLAC/ALAC, stem export
tools.acceptance: SingleExport writes a valid -14 LUFS WAV/AAC

tools.name: EchoelSeq
tools.live: 8 tracks x 16 steps, 30-300 BPM, 16th-note clock, on/off steps
tools.acceptance: BeatTab plays a pattern at set BPM; play/stop responds

tools.name: EchoelMIDI
tools.live: MIDI 2.0 + MPE input -> EngineBus.controllerEvents -> synth notes (performer priority)
tools.roadmap: Standard MIDI File I/O, MIDI output, touch instruments, audio-to-MIDI
tools.acceptance: External MPE controller triggers synth notes

tools.name: EchoelBio
tools.live: HealthKit + Polar H10 (BLE direct, RR->RMSSD) + Demo -> bioFrames; breath/motion onset events
tools.roadmap: face tracking (ARKit), raw PPG/ECG waveform -> heartbeat events
tools.acceptance: BioStripView shows live HR/HRV/Br/Coh; Demo source works on Simulator

tools.name: EchoelVis
tools.roadmap: generative & AR worlds, Hilbert-map display, flow field, kaleidoscope, nebula
tools.acceptance: A Metal visual renders without GPU validation errors at >=60 fps

tools.name: EchoelVid
tools.roadmap: NLE editor, multi-cam, H.265/ProRes, 1080p/4K, LUT grading, RTMP streaming
tools.acceptance: Records a valid short-form MP4 to the photo library

tools.name: EchoelLux
tools.roadmap: DMX-512, Art-Net 4 (UDP 6454), HomeKit, fixture profiles, cue lists

tools.name: EchoelStage
tools.roadmap: external displays, projection mapping (warp/edge-blend), multi-screen, NDI/Syphon, AirPlay

tools.name: EchoelNet
tools.live: OSC 1.0/UDP, big-endian floats, ~100ms cadence, 6 bio addresses /echoelmusic/bio/*, default localhost:8000
tools.roadmap: Ableton Link tempo/phase, bidirectional OSC, OSC for controller/bio events
tools.acceptance: OSC frames reach a LAN receiver (Resolume/TouchDesigner/Sonic Pi)

tools.name: EchoelAI
tools.roadmap: on-device CoreML, stem separation (private, no cloud)

testflightBuild1.scope: ship LIVE + the LIVE part of PARTIAL; exclude EchoelLux/Stage/AI and all ROADMAP rows
acceptance: Bio strip shows live HR/HRV/coherence (Demo on Simulator)
OSC streams bio out over UDP
